effect: The resilient world brings variation, movement and refuge together, while clarifying that none guarantees survival.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making adaptation was most worthwhile: its explanation connected inherited differences to survival and reproduction while acknowledging trade-offs.

leastWorthwhile.text: The corridor and refuge sequence felt thin: the results fit the goal, but did not explain how the river connected habitats or how seasonal journeys created refuge.

surprise.text: Forest rain was an interesting connection; the transpiration explanation showed how forests can help sustain rainfall beyond individual trees.

arbitrary.text: Combining adaptation with a wildlife corridor to make a changing range felt underexplained, even if the broad connection to responding to change made sense.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, cautiously: the educational clarifications and final picture of resilience are engaging, although some intermediate combinations need clearer mechanisms.
